scope: P1 native gateway HTTP/bootstrap/status, standard refresh, shared DI and bounded replay-cache maintenance
behaviors: Native-only bootstrap requires idempotency/observed versions/client build and returns only public Matrix identity plus opaque gateway credentials, no-store.
Status exposes safe gateway version/build/expiry metadata; token values, hashes and encrypted response never appear there.
POST Matrix v3 refresh uses only its JSON refresh token, with a separate stateless security chain. A native bearer/cookie cannot replace that authority.
Matrix response/error shapes, latest-response replay, rate bounds and permission removal are exercised through actual HTTP and PostgreSQL.
Known-length and chunked request bodies above 2 KiB, duplicate/trailing/deep/unknown/non-JSON shapes are rejected.
Every unimplemented Matrix/Synapse route stays denied, including login/logout/admin/federation/sync.

The actual worker graph provisions a fictional Matrix device, creates an expired encrypted gateway cache, interrupts cleanup after the SQL write, verifies rollback, terminates its timer/queue, then clears only the cache in a later pass.
Disabled worker creates no cleanup timer/task. Rejected scheduling leaves it stopped; invalid batch limits fail.
Generation exhaustion maps to reauthentication without deleting the retained device/history.

correctedFailures.result: Jackson 3 JsonFactory package is tools.jackson.core.json; corrected the import. No production runtime was changed.

limits: Final worker selection includes one unchanged opt-in elapsed retention skip; all other cases passed.
Native HTTP fixture controls activation to isolate transport/DI. Real provider activation and cleanup ownership are exercised separately by the actual worker fixture.
The parser checks a two-second elapsed budget between reads and inherits the five-second server socket timeout; it does not promise a hard two-second interrupt of a blocked servlet read.
The private provider is not proxied. Sync, content/media and SDK product ownership, browser admission and all chat/call/meeting acceptance remain required.
